name: ai.privos.mcp-app-onboarding-dev
title: PrivOS Onboarding MCP App (Dev)
description: Onboard room members with required learning materials, knowledge checks, essay feedback, and Admin evaluations in PrivOS.

permissions.reason: Load the approved PrivOS installation and room context for onboarding.
Join the installation-owned onboarding service bot to the current room before room-scoped database calls.
Use Hub-signed room and workspace roles to separate Admin and Learner access.
List and validate current-room members before an Admin assigns onboarding.
Notify assigned members, send due reminders, and announce published evaluations.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Assignments, reminders, and evaluations remain saved, but the app shows that the notification could not be delivered.

permissions.reason: Open room-scoped onboarding files and learning materials.
Upload Admin-authored onboarding resources to the current room.
Read room-scoped templates, assignments, progress, attempts, feedback, evaluations, and audit records.
Persist room-scoped onboarding state through the server-side policy gateway.
Verify the registered onboarding App Database schema for the current room.
Register versioned onboarding collections and indexes for the current room.

dataPolicy.retention: Onboarding data is retained in the room-scoped App Database until the installation or corresponding records are deleted.
